# dynaura

> Dynamic Island style toasts for the web. One pill that spring-morphs between states, swipes away and stays out of your way. Zero dependencies, typed, themeable. React, Vue, Svelte and vanilla JS. MIT licensed.

dynaura is an npm package by Ashutosh Swamy. Install with `npm install dynaura`, mount one `<Toaster />`, import `dynaura/styles.css` once, then call `dynaura.success({ title: "Saved" })` from anywhere.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://dynaura.ashutoshswamy.in/docs): what dynaura is and why it exists
- [Installation](https://dynaura.ashutoshswamy.in/docs/installation): npm, pnpm, yarn or bun, plus the stylesheet
- [Quick start](https://dynaura.ashutoshswamy.in/docs/quick-start): React, Vue, Svelte and vanilla setup
- [Recipes](https://dynaura.ashutoshswamy.in/docs/recipes): actions, promises, progress, live activities, rich cards, queue, positions
- [Playground](https://dynaura.ashutoshswamy.in/docs/playground): change every option and copy the code
- [Examples](https://dynaura.ashutoshswamy.in/docs/examples): feedback, async, live, cards, social and commerce
- [Theming](https://dynaura.ashutoshswamy.in/docs/theming): dark, light, system and custom themes
- [Gestures](https://dynaura.ashutoshswamy.in/docs/gestures): hover, tap, long-press and swipe
- [API](https://dynaura.ashutoshswamy.in/docs/api): methods, toast options, Toaster options, entry points
- [Accessibility](https://dynaura.ashutoshswamy.in/docs/accessibility): aria-live, focus and reduced motion
- [How it works](https://dynaura.ashutoshswamy.in/docs/how-it-works): internals, adapters, development, releasing
- [Troubleshooting](https://dynaura.ashutoshswamy.in/docs/troubleshooting): common fixes
